fact: On interviews held between September 2020 and March 2021, the World Bank brief states that most primary health care units and many primary health care centres lack computers or tablets for entering data, that County Health Departments are intended to be the focal point for DHIS2 data entry and uploading, and that facility-based data entry is put forward only as a pilot for high-volume facilities, among about 1,900 public health facilities.
title: Heath Service Monitoring in South Sudan: Use of Technology for Monitoring Health Services. Policy Brief 5/5
